india.one_line: Indian judiciary, defense, and academia see new AI initiatives spanning legal guidelines, naval training, and research funding.

themes.title: Google funds AI research at IIT Kharagpur
themes.text: Google has committed $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for research in Indic languages, materials science, agriculture, and educational technology.

stories.headline: Google announces $5M funding for IIT Kharagpur for advanced AI research

themes.title: CJI urges guidelines for AI in law
themes.text: Chief Justice Surya Kant called for model guidelines regarding AI disclosure in legal research and warned against unreliable AI detection software.

stories.headline: CJI Surya Kant urges AI disclosure guidelines for legal research

themes.title: Indian Navy officers train in LLM fine-tuning
themes.text: Parshu Tactical Defence conducted a workshop at INS Valsura where over 56 Indian Navy officers trained and deployed large language models.

stories.headline: Parshu Tactical Defence trains Indian Navy officers in LLM fine-tuning
